description: Helping retail customers set, plan for and track financial goals, self-directed or advised.
Customers define financial goals and build plans to reach them using digital tools.
Projecting retirement outcomes from balances, contributions and life-expectancy assumptions.
Scoring and explaining a customer's overall financial health.
Generating educational, non-personalized insights and nudges from a customer's plan and portfolio.
Personalized recommendations delivered by or under the supervision of licensed associates.
Knowing, identifying and serving customers and clients.
Identifying and authenticating customers and managing their entitlements.
Maintaining a customer's employment, life-event, financial and risk profile.
Opening, maintaining and reporting on customer accounts.
Maintaining authoritative account balances and positions.
Managing legal, regulatory, compliance and surveillance obligations.
Retention, disposition and legal hold of business records.
Detecting and investigating conduct and fraud risks.
Managing shared reference data such as locations, calendars, currencies and mortality tables.
